The '''Dulok battleship''' was a [[canoe]] built by [[Gorneesh's tribe]] of [[Dulok/Legends|Duloks]] on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. [[King/Legends|King]] [[Gorneesh/Legends|Gorneesh]] intended to use the battleship to plunder the [[Fishing Festival]] of the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] of [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] and steal all their [[Fish/Legends|fish]]. However, the Ewoks [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Wystri Warrick]], [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]], [[Latara/Legends|Latara]], and [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka]] foiled his plan when they teamed up with a colony of [[skib]]s to destroy the watercraft.
